kuala-lumpur-2008.notes: Source 2 (scoreboard index page) has no copy; its content is the frame page that shows source 3 inside source 1's crawl. A 21-page 2008 problem set PDF held in the 2010 and 2011 site copies has a cover dated 20th December 2008, while the 2008 site says 15-16 December.

sources.evidence: Seed page titled 'ACM-ICPC Regional Programming Contest Malaysia 2008 - Kuala Lumpur Site' gives 15th - 16th December 2008 at International Islamic University Malaysia.
Table of 58 team rows with columns Rank, Name, Solved, Time, A to K and Total att/solv, headed 'ACM ICPC Asia Regional Contest 2008, Kuala Lumpur Site'.
UVa Online Judge page titled 'ACM ICPC Malaysia Regional Contest 2008' with a table of eleven problems (A) to (K).
Baekjoon category page 'Asia Regional 2008 - Kuala Lumpur' with a table of a single problem, A.

kuala-lumpur-2010.notes: Source 1: the 2010 site copy contains the 2008 archive pages (scoreboard summary.html, 21-page 2008 problem set kual2008.pdf); the cover of kual2008.pdf says 20th December 2008, which differs from the 15-16 December 2008 given on the 2008 site; worth a look when kuala-lumpur-2008's date is reviewed.

sources.evidence: Home page titled 'ACM ICPC Asia Regional 2010 - Kuala Lumpur' states 8th - 9th December 2010 and names the International Islamic University Malaysia as organizer.
Two-page PDF table with columns Rank, Name, Solved, Time, listing 66 teams from rank 1 to 17 and then 40 teams marked HM.
Table of 66 team rows with columns Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time, Citation, headed 'The 2010 ACM-ICPC Asia Kuala Lumpur Regional Contest'.
18-page PDF whose cover reads 'The 2010 ACM ASIA Programming Contest Kuala Lumpur Site', 9th December, 2010, 10 Problems, 300 Minutes.

kuala-lumpur-2011.notes: Source 4 is also linked inside the source 1 crawl. The al-Khawarizmi results page lists 50 ranked rows while the report says 42 teams took part in that national contest; not described with a count. Source 1's Result link (frame page) points to a scoreboard that is not in the copy.

sources.evidence: Home page titled 'ACM-ICPC Asia Regional Kuala Lumpur 2011' states 12th - 13th November 2011 and names the International Islamic University Malaysia as organizer.
Table of 60 team rows with columns Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time, Citation, headed 'The 2011 ACM-ICPC Asia Kuala Lumpur Regional Contest'.
18-page PDF titled 'ACM ICPC Asia Regional 2011 Kuala Lumpur Problem Set' stating 9 questions (A-I).

kuala-lumpur-2014.notes: Source 5 (file icpc-regional-2014-analysis-teddy.pdf, catalogued as editorial) is contest-analysis statistics slides with no solution explanations, so I set it to report; it is not an editorial under the rubric. Also, the cover of source 3 says 26 pages but the file has 27 (not a defect of the copy as far as seen).
